# Support

- **Docs:** start with [README.md](../README.md), then `docs/` (`SHORTCUTS.md`,
  `ARCHITECTURE.md`, `DEVELOPMENT.md`).
- **Bugs / features:** GitHub Issues (use the templates).
- **Security:** [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md) only — not public issues.
- **Agent / contributor notes:** [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md),
  [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md).
